notes: Outline redrawn 2026-11-20 under the owner's new rules (edge on paper between the innermost rule and the first map ink; ruled boxes at the margin are notches; no holes; legend/title blocks, compass roses and SECTION badges go in 'remove'). Sides: placed from pixel profiles across the frame at every px along each side (outer bar, white hairline, thin inner rule), on the first 1-2 px of paper inside the thin rule's inner edge, never on the rule or in the hairline; where map ink lies within a few px of the rule the edge runs in the paper gap between them, and where map ink truly touches the rule it follows the rule's inner edge (estimated from the neighbouring clean stretches and the bar's outer edge). Points every 15-50 px, so the bowed rules are followed. Corners (rule 2): the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc was traced from the scan (circle fit to the measured edge, then the edge measured along the outline), the outline ~1-2 px inside it; where the arc leaves the side rule (a short stub inside the rule) the outline goes round the stub, so the stub stays outside. Kind (b): along the top (x ~1000-2150) the diagonal hatch lines of the hatched blocks run into the top rule and the outline follows the rule's inner edge across them; on the right at y ~380-460 the letters of a street name print against the rule (their strokes join it) and the outline runs along the rule's edge over them; on the right above y ~1700 the thin rule and the bar print as one band and the outline follows that band's inner edge. A small blob at (363, 432), ~15 px inside the left rule where the top-left arc leaves it, is left outside (doubt: likely the broken tip of the arc's stub). remove: (1) the CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title, LEGEND and scale-bar block (bottom left, rectangle on blank paper, former hole kept); (2) the compass rose with north arrow, needle and tail (bottom right, former hole kept); (3) the SECTION 14 badge, redrawn as a 10-point outline ~3.5 px outside the ring: its bottom edge runs on the 1-2 px of paper above the hatched blocks, its lower right just clear of the right block's top-left corner, and its top edge lies on the frame rule because the ring's top merges with the inner rule (only frame ink there). The outline itself stays on the rule's edge across the badge (no notch). No other holes; no ruled box at the margin. 'Join Sec. 5' (top) and 'Join Sec. 13' (right) print outside the frame bars. PACIFIC OCEAN, UNITED STATES MILITARY RESERVATION, LAGUNA DE LA MERCED, the county-line labels and the golf-club names stay map.
